Actor Sonu Sood comments on long queues for new iPhone

Actor Sonu Sood took to social media to comment on the long queues of people waiting to purchase the new iPhone 18. He shared a photograph and made a remark about the situation, which was reported by Hindi media outlets. The actor's comment alluded to the recurring nature of such queues for new phone releases and the associated payment plans.
